observation.command: cat /proc/net/tcp /proc/net/tcp6 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR>1 && $4=="0A" {split($2,a,":"); print strtonum("0x" a[2])}' | sort -un | tr '\n' ' '; echo; echo "=== who is listening: check /proc for 18011 ==="; for pid in $(ls /proc | grep -E '^[0-9]+$'); do if ls -l /proc/$pid/fd 2>/dev/null | grep -q socket; then :; fi; done; echo "=== curl 18011 again ==="; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -m 3 http://localhost:18011/docs 2>&1
